in_marathi.name: Grija
in_marathi.long_meaning: Grija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'grih' meaning house or dwelling. The name Grija represents a lady or wife. In Hindu mythology, Griha is also the name of a goddess, the wife of the god Indra.
